Outfit Photo Extraction

Upload a single outfit photo and automatically extract individual clothing items into the wardrobe.
Pipeline: GPT-4o vision (identify + bounding boxes) → crop with padding → rembg background removal → clean individual item images.

Step 1Upload outfit photo
→
Step 2GPT-4o identifies items + bounding boxes (~5s)
→
Step 3Crop each item with 15% padding
→
Step 4rembg removes background (~3s/item)
→
Step 5GPT-4o analyzes each item + add to wardrobe
